data.one_liner: Provides consistent, screen-size responsive gaps and margins between widgets based on Material breakpoints.
data.what_it_does: It automatically sizes gaps and margins according to the current screen size and Material Design responsive layout system. It detects the axis direction from parent widgets automatically or via context configurations.
use_when: You want gaps and margins that automatically adapt to screen sizes and Material breakpoints.
You want spacing widgets that automatically adapt to row or column axes without manual height/width specifications.
avoid_when: You need fixed pixel spacing that never changes across screen sizes.
You prefer using the standard Gap package with explicit sizes.
strengths: Auto-sizes gap spacing according to Material breakpoints.
Detects the axis of arbitrary widgets automatically or via configuration.
Provides convenient BuildContext extensions for gutter and margin sizes.
weaknesses: Dynamic axis checks use runtime reflection/checks which may slightly increase bundle size.
Relies on Material Design responsive layout concepts.
